dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical, gradual narrowing of the 2D silhouette from the mid-body toward the posterior region.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median light-grey pixel intensity across the visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low spatial frequency of diffuse, slightly lighter grey patches on the mid-dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between subtle tonal variations.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple fine, linear, intersecting light-grey marks across the central and right dorsal planes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Superficial linear markings consistent with rake marks on the dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Single distinct, dark circular aperture at the anterior midline.
